content.en_us:
How to get it :
- [[Assembly Machine|Assembly Machine]] : 4 x [[gv:circuit_pcb|Printed Circuit Board]], 4 x ingot (plastic), 8 x wire (Tungsten), Niobium Ingot.
- [[Soldering Station|Soldering Station]] : 3 x [[gv:circuit_vacuum_tube|Vacuum Tube]], 2 x [[gv:circuit_capacitor|Capacitor]], 4 x [[gv:circuit_pcb|Printed Circuit Board]], 4 x wire (Lead).

Used to make :
[[Electric Arc Furnace|Electric Arc Furnace]], [[Centrifuge|Centrifuge]], [[Chemical Plant|Chemical Plant]], [[Compressor|Compressor]], [[Excavator|Large Mining Drill]], [[Oil Refinery|Oil Refinery]], [[gv:mp_c_2|Tier 2 Missile Targeting Circuit]], [[gv:oil_detector|Oil Reservoir Detector]], [[RBMK Console|RBMK Console]], [[RBMK Crane Console|RBMK Crane Console]] and 3 more.
